name: xor_scramble_word_pairs
description: Walks a block of 16-bit words, replacing each word with its XOR against the next word and a fixed mask. The loop count is taken from the incoming length value.

name: invoke_subroutine_five_times
description: Calls the same subroutine five times in a row with no other work between the calls. It repeats that one step a fixed number of times.

name: call_routine_if_flag_set
description: Calls a subroutine once, then calls it a second time only when the shared flag byte is non-zero.

name: release_library_during_cleanup
description: Calls a single subroutine and returns. Its recorded callees include the wrapper that closes an exec library, so it runs as part of library teardown.

name: parse_log_file_argument
description: Parses an argument string. A leading at-sign leads to a check for a following S or s, which sets a shared flag. Otherwise it validates the text and checks for colon or slash path separators before accepting it.

name: forward_log_setup_call
description: Calls one subroutine and returns, with no logic of its own. It sits in the log-file setup path, as the referenced log file text suggests.

name: copy_token_until_delimiter
description: Copies characters from the source string to the destination, starting after an optional opening double quote. It stops at a space, a newline or the matching quote, then writes a terminating zero.

name: scan_string_for_stop_characters
description: Scans a string for a two-character marker and returns zero when it finds one. It returns minus one as soon as either of two other marker characters appears first.

name: return_minus_one_status
description: Returns a fixed failure value of minus one in the upper half of the result and passes the stack value through in the lower half. It is a small stub with no other work and may be padding in a gap that decodes as code.

name: scan_text_for_marker_status
description: Scans a string and returns zero when the character after the current position matches one of two codes. It returns minus one when it meets one of two other codes first.

name: load_file_into_memory
description: Locks a file, examines it to get its size, allocates a buffer of that size and reads the file into it. It unlocks and closes the file before returning the result.

name: write_buffer_to_file
description: Opens a file through the dos library, writes the supplied buffer to it and closes it again. It returns zero when the open succeeds and minus one when it fails.

name: write_null_terminated_text
description: Finds the end of a zero-terminated string and passes the text to the dos write call. It returns the original register values it was given.

name: open_dos_library_and_check
description: Opens dos.library through the exec OldOpenLibrary call, then calls two library functions on it. It returns zero when all three steps succeed and one otherwise.

name: allocate_tracked_memory_slot
description: Finds the first free entry in a table of allocation records and calls the exec AllocMem routine with the requested size. It stores the block address and size in that entry, or clears the size if allocation fails.

name: free_tracked_memory_blocks
description: Walks the allocation table from the start and calls the exec FreeMem routine on each entry it reaches, stopping at the first empty entry.

name: build_sorted_directory_listing
description: Opens dos.library and walks a listing of the referenced directory paths, copying each name into a table. It sorts the table, then writes out fixed-size records that each carry a name string.

name: build_records_from_matching_names
description: Compares names in a table with a key while ignoring letter case. For each match it appends a fixed-size record, copies in the name and writes a numbered suffix into a path string, then returns the byte offset of the last record.

name: save_args_and_call_library
description: Saves its two register arguments in shared variables, calls a library function through the stored library base, then calls two more library functions and returns.

name: save_args_and_call_library
description: Saves its two register arguments in shared variables, calls a library function through the stored library base, then calls two more library functions and returns.

name: open_read_close_via_dos
description: Saves its two register arguments, calls the dos library to open a file, then calls two more dos functions that read and close it. It returns the saved values.

name: run_startup_setup_sequence
description: Runs the startup sequence. It builds eight numbered label records, splits a text buffer into lines on marker characters, makes library and hardware calls, and waits in a loop. The decompiled output is cut off before the end, so later steps are unknown.

name: run_startup_setup_sequence
description: Runs the startup sequence. It builds eight numbered label records, splits a text buffer into lines on marker characters, makes library and hardware calls, and waits in a loop. The decompiled output is cut off before the end, so later steps are unknown.

name: run_startup_setup_sequence
description: Entry routine for the executable. It finds the current task, then runs the startup sequence that builds eight numbered label records and splits a text buffer into lines on marker characters. It waits on message ports and loops before returning, and the output is cut off before the end.

name: setup_hardware_and_load_data
description: Opens the graphics and dos libraries, loads the game data files from the named paths, and takes over the blitter. It then writes the copper and DMA control registers to start the display and waits for the next frame.

name: poll_key_and_store_input
description: Calls the input routine and returns early when the key code is the escape code. For any other non-zero key it copies a 16-byte block into a buffer and stores the key byte.

name: clear_word_buffer
description: Writes zero into 32 consecutive 16-bit words starting at the buffer address.

name: classify_control_key_input
description: Checks the incoming key code. A space or newline sets a shared marker word, and the control codes from 28 to 31 set a shared flag to 255 and clear a state byte.

name: match_string_table_entry
description: Walks a list of zero-terminated entries and compares each with a name string. On a match it stores the associated value in a shared variable and returns, and it stops at an end marker.

name: forward_to_subroutine
description: Calls one subroutine and returns. It is a pass-through wrapper that three callers reach.

name: clear_state_and_call_handler
description: Calls a routine, clears a shared state word, calls another routine, then calls the function pointer saved in a shared variable.

name: initialize_display_state_buffers
description: Clears two large word buffers and splits an input block into two arrays. It resets many shared state variables, then runs a series of calls and returns early if a prior result is non-zero.

name: seed_counters_and_fill_table
description: Sets three 32-bit counters to a base of 15000 when they are zero, then derives their differences and a weighted average. It writes a fixed pattern into a short table of records and calls a helper for each record.

name: write_comma_and_repeat_byte
description: Calls a routine, writes a comma character to the output buffer, and calls a routine again. It then writes a shared byte into two consecutive output bytes.

name: sort_records_by_key_fields
description: Fills a table of five-word records with their indices, then sorts them by comparing up to three key fields. Records are swapped whenever the comparison puts them out of order.

name: convert_number_to_decimal_text
description: Converts an unsigned 32-bit value to decimal digit characters, capped at 99999, and suppresses leading zeros. A zero value is written as a single zero character.

name: write_four_digit_decimal_text
description: Writes a 16-bit value as four decimal digit characters, capped at 9999. A zero value writes four zero characters.

name: copy_twelve_byte_record
description: Copies a 12-byte entry from a table, selected by the index in the low word, into an output record as one 4-byte and one 2-byte field, then a second 4-byte and 2-byte pair.

name: validate_settings_block
description: Copies up to eight table entries into a work area, then compares a set of stored settings with expected values. It sets a result flag to minus one when any setting differs.

name: shift_buffer_past_ampersand
description: If the first character of a text buffer is an ampersand, shifts the next 18 bytes one place forward to drop it and writes a zero terminator. The same shift is repeated a second time.

name: reset_audio_and_display_state
description: Clears state variables and counters, copies lookup values into working fields, and sets up the four audio volume registers, the copper and the DMA control register. It calls several helpers before returning.

name: write_newline_to_two_outputs
description: Calls a routine, writes a newline byte to one output pointer, calls the routine again, then writes a newline byte to a second output pointer.

name: build_scaled_index_table
description: Copies a list of 16-bit entries into an index table, stopping at the first value below 257, and ends the list with minus one. When a flag is set it fills a 128-step table by scaling values from a sample table with a per-step multiplier.

name: skip_strings_by_computed_count
description: Computes a count from two shared values, then walks forward past that many zero-terminated strings in the data area.

name: skip_strings_by_second_count
description: Skips a number of zero-terminated strings in the data area, with the count derived from a shared value and a second multiplier. It walks the strings the same way as its sibling routine, using a different count.

name: poll_fire_button_flags
description: Chooses one of two sets of three shared words depending on a countdown and the fire button bit read from the joystick port register. It then advances a frame counter and sets two flag bits when a position value falls within two ranges.

name: reset_state_and_clear_buffer
description: Clears two shared counters and a 64-entry block of 32-bit words, copies a shared value into a state variable, calls a routine, then clears a flag.

name: wait_for_fire_button_press
description: Samples the two fire-button bits of the button port repeatedly, waiting for the required pattern to appear. It returns the saved input value when the pattern is found.

name: wait_for_fire_button_match
description: Waits until one fire-button bit reads high, then until the second bit is set and the sampling routine returns zero. It returns the saved input value.

name: derive_packed_and_offset_values
description: Builds derived words from a shared input value: a packed word, two adjusted copies, and two accumulators that grow by the input halves. The results are stored in shared variables.

name: fill_block_cells_from_table
description: Walks a table of records and, for each record with a non-zero index, fills an 8-by-8 block of 32-bit cells in a buffer. The cells are either set to a fixed value or copied from source data, depending on a flag.

name: adjust_bounded_level_from_input
description: Converts a shared input value to a starting level, then raises or lowers it by one while the button and status flags allow. The level stays between 1 and 127, and the routine returns it shifted left by nine bits.

name: fill_pattern_table_and_mask
description: Fills a 127-entry table of 32-bit words with a repeating pattern, substituting a marker value at one index. It then ORs a bit mask into a word at a computed address.

name: process_button_input_records
description: Processes a table of records, comparing pairs of entries by their position fields and updating the entries and counters. It reads the fire and right and middle button port registers as part of the input step and calls several helpers.

name: dispatch_record_command
description: Reads a command code from a record and dispatches on it. Code 0 stores an operand and calls a routine, code 1 stores a 32-bit value in a table slot, code 2 stores a 16-bit value, and code 5 scales a value before storing it.

name: spin_until_byte_wraps
description: Increments a shared byte in a loop until it wraps to zero with its low bit clear, then returns. It is a busy-wait with no other work.

name: spin_until_byte_wraps
description: Increments a shared byte in a loop until it wraps to zero with its low bit clear, then returns. It is a busy-wait with no other work.

name: spin_wait_for_video_position
description: Increments a shared byte until it wraps to zero with its low bit clear, which is a busy-wait. The listing also touches the video position registers, so this wait is tied to the display position.

name: wait_for_byte_match_sync
description: Busy-waits until a shared byte equals the argument byte and its low bit is clear. The listing touches the video position registers, so the wait is tied to the display position.

name: wait_for_zero_sync_byte
description: Busy-waits until a shared byte reads zero, repeating while its low bit is clear. The listing touches the video position registers.

name: wait_for_sync_byte_value
description: Busy-waits for a shared byte to match a value. If the argument's high flag bit is set, the value comes from a routine call; otherwise it is the low byte of the argument. It also waits for the low bit to clear.

name: run_frame_update_loop
description: Runs the per-frame loop, calling a long series of routines and clearing two counters when their flags are set. It returns early when a button bit is clear, and otherwise advances an index in a table and updates two words from it.

name: reset_state_blocks_when_flagged
description: If the two tested values are not both zero, clears a 22-entry block of 32-bit words and sets a marker word to minus one. Otherwise it calls a routine. The same test is then applied to a second block.

name: advance_blitter_countdown_state
description: Decrements a countdown and, when it reaches zero, reloads it and updates a state byte. It then sets blitter registers and calls the blitter wait routine.

name: initialize_record_fields
description: Stores the incoming register values and a computed pointer into fixed offsets of a record and clears several fields. It sets one 16-bit field to 386, and replaces a zero helper result with 10 before using it.

name: call_two_handlers_in_sequence
description: Calls two subroutines in sequence and returns. It is a plain sequencing wrapper.

name: check_entry_hit_with_margin
description: Checks whether a probe position falls inside a list entry's bounds, allowing a margin of seven units. On a hit it increments the entry's counter and records a pointer for the caller.

name: process_keyboard_serial_input
description: Reads a keyboard code from the serial register once its ready bit is set, then decodes it. The escape code sets a marker, the P and S keys toggle two flags, and the R, C and Q keys set state words when a shared flag is set.

name: program_blitter_from_table
description: Counts down a delay, then selects a source address from a table entry and programs the blitter size, mode and pointer registers. It waits for the blitter to finish before starting the blit.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Returns at once with no work. It is an empty stub entry in the executable.

name: update_two_counters_and_words
description: Updates two counters that step with a limit and reset when they pass a bound. It then writes one of two fixed sets of three shared words, depending on the counter values.

name: pick_shade_from_distance
description: Scales two input values into a clamped range and picks a shade word from distance thresholds of 25, 10 and 4. It applies the shade on each axis only when the related flags are clear.

name: process_record_list_until_marker
description: Walks ten three-word records and skips empty ones. Negative records call one pair of routines, positive records call another pair, and a marker value of minus two ends the walk.

name: apply_offset_when_in_bounds
description: Tests whether an entry lies within a bounding range around a reference point. If it does, the routine subtracts a shared offset from the entry's 32-bit position field.

name: add_offset_when_in_bounds
description: Tests whether an entry lies within the same bounding range used by its partner. If it does, the routine adds a shared offset to the entry's 32-bit position field instead of subtracting it.

name: tick_timed_entries_and_reload
description: Walks ten timed entries. For each active entry it checks a bitmap cell against a mask and clears the entry if the cell is blocked. Otherwise it counts the entry down and, at zero, reloads it and searches a list for a free slot.

name: advance_scroll_and_write_rows
description: Returns early when the scroll step is zero. Otherwise it waits in a loop on a status bit, advances two accumulator values, and writes a set of row entries computed from them.

name: advance_scroll_and_write_rows
description: Returns early when the scroll step is zero. Otherwise it waits in a loop on a status bit, advances two accumulator values, and writes a set of row entries computed from them.

name: advance_scroll_and_write_rows
description: Returns early when the scroll step is zero. Otherwise it waits in a loop on a status bit, advances two accumulator values, and writes a set of row entries computed from them.

name: advance_scroll_and_write_rows
description: Returns early when the scroll step is zero. Otherwise it waits in a loop on a status bit, advances two accumulator values, and writes a set of row entries computed from them.

name: blit_scrolled_block_rows
description: Advances the scroll accumulators, then programs the blitter's mask, modulo, pointer, control and size registers to copy a block of rows.

name: compute_entry_position_from_index
description: Looks up two values from tables by index and stores them, shifted, into the entry's two 32-bit fields. It then adjusts two word fields of the entry by offsets.

name: update_entry_position_or_clear
description: If the index is below 17, updates the entry's two words from table values and adds a constant offset. Otherwise it clears the entry's two words and returns minus one.

name: update_entries_by_state
description: A long routine that branches on a state value and counters, then calls about ten helper routines to update entries. The decompiled output is partly unreadable, so its exact effect is only partly clear.

name: apply_motion_type_to_velocity
description: Clears a status word, then applies a motion type to a pair of velocity values. Type 1 negates them and sets a timer, type 2 sets a flag and adds a table step, type 3 adds a table step, and any other type divides them by four.

name: step_entry_positions_by_type
description: Returns at once when a timer is negative. Otherwise it moves position fields by fixed steps according to the entry's type code, subtracting 25 from the timer each time it moves an entry.

name: set_field_to_fifteen
description: Sets a word to 15 when the entry's type byte equals 2, then calls a routine.

name: scan_positions_until_check_passes
description: Tests successive positions, stepping by a fixed amount each time, until a check routine returns non-zero or the step limit is reached. It returns the current input values.

name: initialize_entry_if_active
description: Returns when the entry's first word is zero. Otherwise it initialises a set of fields in the entry, including a 32-bit sentinel value and a pointer, and sets one field to 38.

name: update_entry_position_with_bounds
description: Adds motion values to an entry's position, then clamps it against bounds. A negative horizontal position is reset to zero and a flag is set, and the other limits are checked in turn, with 333 as the upper horizontal limit.

name: store_clamped_coordinates_on_flag
description: When a flag is set and one of two counters is negative, it clears the flag, writes a clamped pair of coordinates into the output, and zeroes the entry's two words.

name: subtract_deltas_when_flags_clear
description: Subtracts two stored delta values from a pair of position words when a flag is clear, and does the same for a second pair under another flag. A saved word is restored between the two steps.

name: compute_distance_squared_and_shade
description: Computes the squared distance between an entry and a reference point, reduced by a shift. Inside the threshold it looks up a value from a table, lowers a counter when that value is small, and returns the looked-up pair. Otherwise it returns the squared distance.

name: copy_pairs_with_halved_offset
description: Copies the first word of each source pair into two output tables. It writes a transformed second word into both tables: the source value halved, masked and increased by 276.

name: place_position_marker_entries
description: Compares a position with reference values and writes a marker character into the output buffer. It then sets fields in a list of twelve small entries to fixed values.

name: stop_audio_and_set_dma
description: Computes a level from flags and halves it, then clears the audio channel pointers and volume values and waits in a loop. It finishes by writing the DMA control word.

name: advance_sequence_pointer_entry
description: When the source pointer is null, stores a default pointer and a count of 2. Otherwise it copies three words from the source entry, advances the pointer, and stores the result.

name: reverse_velocity_on_collision
description: Checks two entries against a wall-like condition and, when a helper reports a hit, reverses that entry's velocity. It then sets a related pointer, or resets the velocity to zero in some cases.

name: update_pair_state_on_hit
description: Swaps two stored value pairs, then checks a type code in the range 7 to 9. When a helper reports a hit, it sets the type to 8 and raises two counters by 50 each, up to set caps.

name: test_bitmap_cell_collision
description: Computes a bitmap address from two coordinates, combines three 32-bit words from it, and tests a shifted bit mask against them.

name: scroll_and_build_list_entry
description: Adjusts two scroll values by fixed steps and wraps them past a boundary. Depending on a flag it then builds a list entry with a fixed header value and pointers, writing two words into it.

name: build_list_node_from_record
description: Adjusts scroll values, then fills a list node from the input record with a fixed header value, pointers and a fixed size field. It also wraps the scroll values when they pass a boundary.

name: fill_list_node_fields
description: Calls a helper and stores its word together with fixed fields into a list node: a cleared word, a minus-one sentinel, two pointers, the value 36 and the value 1731. It also calls the blitter wait routine.

name: fill_list_node_masked
description: Calls a helper, masks its word with a fixed value and stores it with the same fixed fields into a list node. It also calls the blitter wait routine.

name: blit_active_entries_in_loop
description: Loops over ten entries and, for each non-zero entry, waits for the blitter and programs its control, modulo, pointer and size registers. It then writes a list node for that entry.

name: queue_blit_node_after_wait
description: Waits until a status bit clears, then writes a list node with a masked input word, a minus-one sentinel and fixed fields for the blit.

name: blit_active_entries_alt_header
description: Loops over ten entries like its sibling routine. For each non-zero entry it waits for the blitter, programs its registers, and writes a list node with a different fixed header value.

name: compute_clamped_weighted_offset
description: Computes a weighted sum from two inputs and a table value, scales it, clamps the result between two fixed limits and adds a base value.

name: update_positions_and_advance_steps
description: Updates two position values from helper results when their flags are clear, then calls ten helper routines to advance the state.

name: try_advance_entry_position
description: Checks a condition on an entry's position and a shared value. When it passes, it subtracts a shared step, advances a counter by three and calls a helper. It returns zero when that helper result is zero, and one otherwise.

name: try_advance_second_entry
description: Applies the same test and step as its sibling routine to the second entry's position and counter.

name: update_countdown_flags_and_timers
description: Handles two pending request flags, calling helpers and recording a pointer for each. It then reduces two timers by one or three steps and clamps the first at zero.

name: apply_velocity_damping_per_frame
description: Checks two helper results and, on a hit, decrements a counter by four. When a flag is set it damps the velocities by one eighth. It then updates the remaining motion fields in a long sequence that depends on counters and flags.

name: update_motion_from_fire_button
description: Shifts the saved button flags, advances a two-step frame index and reads the fire button port. When the button and state flags allow, it subtracts a step from a counter and adds helper results to the velocity values.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Returns at once with no work. It is an empty stub entry in the executable.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Returns at once with no work. It is an empty stub entry in the executable.

name: encode_input_bits_into_byte
description: Packs the bits of an input word into a state byte. The first two bits map to the low bits, and the bits 256 and 512 map to two higher positions chosen by a flag. It also sets a bit from the fire button port and clears two flags when a pointer passes a limit.

name: decode_state_byte_bits
description: Unpacks a state byte into an input word, reversing the packing done by its sibling routine. It clears two flags when a pointer passes a limit.

name: read_joystick_movement_state
description: Reads the mouse and joystick port movement registers and updates a stored state value from the helper results. It increments or resets a counter depending on the input bits and calls several helpers.

name: load_and_parse_text_file
description: Locks a file and examines it for its size, then reads it and parses its contents into a table of entries. It unlocks and closes the file and writes a colour register from the data.

name: store_masked_value_forms
description: Stores a 12-bit value from the input word and sets a sign flag from its top bit. It then writes that value and two shifted, masked derived forms into shared words.

name: allocate_tracked_memory_slot
description: Finds the first free entry in an allocation table and calls the exec AllocMem routine with the requested size. If the table is full it spins forever. It stores the block address and size, or clears the size on failure.

name: free_tracked_memory_blocks
description: Walks the allocation table until an empty entry, freeing each live block with the exec FreeMem routine and skipping slots marked as released.

name: free_tracked_block_by_address
description: Searches the allocation table for an entry matching the given address. When it finds one, it marks the entry as released and calls the exec FreeMem routine on it.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Returns at once with no work. It is an empty stub entry in the executable.

name: restore_system_state_on_exit
description: Restores the system state at exit. It sets the copper and DMA state, waits for the blitter, releases the blitter and reloads the saved view. It then re-enables interrupts, unloads a segment, closes a library and pauses briefly before returning.

name: forbid_and_reply_when_flagged
description: When a shared flag is set, calls the exec Forbid routine and then the ReplyMsg routine. It returns zero in all cases.

name: interpolate_line_points
description: Computes midpoints between two endpoints and steps between them in twenty divisions, writing a point at each step. The starting step depends on a flag.

name: build_padded_bounding_box
description: Builds a box from the input corners, widened by four units on each side. It then walks a fixed set of rows with inner loops that test and record values in a table.

name: iterate_cells_with_stride
description: Walks a grid of four rows by a set of columns, calling a routine for each cell with a fixed large stride. It alternates between two passes and calls one more routine when finished.

name: iterate_cells_with_stride
description: Walks a grid of five rows by a set of columns, calling a routine for each cell with a fixed large stride. It alternates between two passes and calls one more routine when finished.

name: setup_blit_cell_registers
description: Computes a blit offset from two coordinates and writes a fixed set of setup values, including the mask and size fields, to the blitter registers. It waits for the blitter before finishing.

name: setup_blit_line_draw
description: Computes direction flags and error terms for a line between two points, then writes the blitter's control, modulo and pointer registers to draw it.

name: format_numbered_label_text
description: Builds a text label from a character, a digit derived from the argument and a source string. It then copies the result to the destination and clears a shared counter.

name: build_text_rows_with_delay
description: Copies a text string into a buffer, then loops through rows of entries calling helpers and writes a terminator. It sets a delay counter to five and clears two counters before finishing.

name: decode_keyboard_serial_key
description: Counts down a timer and, when the keyboard ready bit is set, reads a keyboard code from the serial register and decodes it. The decoding uses a symbol table of shifted characters.

name: handle_control_code_write
description: Checks a control code. Codes 5 and 7 store a value into a shared byte and return true. Code 8 stores the value twice and may also return true, depending on a flag and the text buffer.

name: render_wrapped_text_line
description: Lays out and draws a text string one character at a time. Spaces and newlines move to the next position, and a line width limit of 317 starts a new line. It calls a drawing routine for each character and calls another routine when finished.

name: render_wrapped_text_with_params
description: Stores its layout arguments in shared words, then lays out and draws a text string with the same spacing, newline and width-limit logic as its sibling. It calls a supplied routine when finished, if one is given.

name: program_blitter_for_block
description: Stores several values from helper results and inputs into shared words, then programs the blitter's mask, modulo, pointer, control and size registers to draw a block. It waits for the blitter to finish.

name: translate_text_control_codes
description: Reads a text string and maps each character through a table of six character pairs, skipping an ampersand sequence. It stops at a null or newline and stores zero in a shared word.

name: update_timeout_and_status_bits
description: Sets a timeout counter to 199 when input or control conditions apply. It then sets two bits in a status word when a position value crosses two thresholds, and clears two shared words.

name: advance_frame_and_toggle_words
description: Increments a frame byte and counts down a timer. When the timer reaches zero it resets it to 10 and XOR-flips two shared 32-bit words.

name: multiply_absolute_values
description: Takes the absolute value of two inputs, then returns a 16-bit product of the high part of one and the low part of the other, together with a rearranged second value.

name: run_steps_when_in_range
description: Tests whether the difference between a position and a stored value lies between minus 16 and 107. Inside that range it calls four routines. Outside it clears two counters.

name: run_steps_in_second_range
description: Applies the same range test as its sibling to a different pair of values. Inside the range it calls four routines. Outside it clears a counter, sets a shared word to a fixed value and calls one routine.

name: initialize_scan_line_table
description: Fills a table of five pointer entries that step by a fixed large stride, then fills a row of 16-bit values starting at 384 and rising by two per entry.

name: initialize_pointer_and_value_tables
description: Fills four pointer entries that step by 42 bytes, then fills a second table of 15 values starting at 386 and rising by two per entry.

name: initialize_position_word_table
description: Writes fixed 16-bit position and size words into a set of table slots, then runs a 544-step loop over the table.

name: compute_entry_pointers_from_index
description: Clamps an index into a range derived from its inputs, then writes pointer fields in an entry, each offset by fixed steps of 42 bytes.

name: pack_entry_word_pair
description: Packs a byte difference and a shifted value into a 16-bit word, adds a fixed offset, masks the high byte and sets a low bit from the input. It stores the resulting pair into the target entry.

name: pack_entry_word_with_flag
description: Adds 4096 to the input word, or 10496 when a flag is set and the target is one of two fixed entries. It masks the high byte, sets a low bit from an input flag, and stores the pair.

name: select_flag_by_target_entry
description: Chooses a flag from one of several shared values depending on which target entry is passed in, and branches to one of several paths. Some paths call one routine.

name: clear_fifteen_longwords
description: Writes zero into 15 consecutive 32-bit words starting after the given pointer.

name: store_masked_control_bits
description: Stores the masked bits of a shared input word into a shared state value, keeping only two bit positions in each byte.

name: decode_port_direction_bits
description: Reads joystick and mouse port movement values and derives direction bits for each. It flips bit values to reconcile the two sources, and clears both when they are equal.

name: build_sprite_list_entry
description: Computes a clamped horizontal offset and writes a sequence of list words for one sprite entry, including a masked control word and fixed header values.

name: build_sprite_entry_and_blit
description: Computes the same clamped offset and sprite list words as its sibling, then programs the blitter registers and waits for the blitter to finish.

name: load_asset_with_blitter_locked
description: Copies a file name from a table entry into a buffer, then takes the blitter and disables interrupts around the load. It releases the blitter and re-enables interrupts afterwards and pauses using the dos delay routine.

name: compute_octant_index
description: Converts two signed deltas into an octant-style index. It records the sign of each delta and the order of their magnitudes, then looks up a value in a table and returns it.

name: dispatch_pending_records
description: Walks a list of twelve-word records and, for each non-zero record with matching flags, calls a routine with the record's byte value. It stops when a status bit is set or the end of the list is reached.

name: insert_record_into_sorted_table
description: Walks a table of 16-bit records to find where a new record belongs, handling empty slots and negative markers. It then inserts the record or shifts entries to keep the table ordered.

name: check_three_bitmap_cells
description: Computes a bitmap address from its inputs and reads three bitmap cells at fixed offsets, testing one bit in each. Both paths return with no stored result, so the test has no visible effect in the listing.

name: insert_entry_into_list
description: Walks a linked list of entries, comparing a computed key, and inserts a new entry at the first free or matching slot. The key is packed from the inputs.

name: prepare_gf2_assign_and_copy
description: Reads text from the dos input and checks it against a prefix length of eleven characters. The command strings it references, assign GF2, copy GF2 and the RAM start script, suggest it sets up an assignment and a copy.

name: write_buffer_to_file
description: Opens a file through the dos library and, if the open succeeds, writes a buffer and closes the file. It returns one on success and zero when the open fails.

name: write_null_terminated_text
description: Finds the end of a zero-terminated string and passes the text to the dos write call. It returns the original register values it was given.

name: open_console_window_handle
description: Opens the dos library, then calls one of its functions, likely to open the console window named in the text, and stores the handle. It returns zero on success and one on failure.

name: close_handle_and_library
description: If the stored file handle is set, closes it through the dos library and then closes the exec library.

name: bulk_assign_initial_values
description: Stores the same input register value into about two dozen shared variables, then returns a fixed pair of values. It is a bulk initialisation of many globals.

name: find_or_append_record_entry
description: Searches a table of 25-word entries for a matching key. When none matches and space remains, it appends a new entry, copies in a name string from the source and stores the smallest of three values. Otherwise it reports the table's current values.

name: copy_name_before_dot
description: Copies a file name into a buffer up to the first period, then terminates it. It resets two pointers to defaults when the source is the buffer, and sets two shared bytes to fixed values when the input is zero.

name: format_two_digit_percentage_text
description: Writes a two-digit percentage of 100 minus a value into the text buffer. When a header identifier matches one of two known values, it computes a second percentage from two header fields and writes it as two digits too.

name: write_flag_status_digits
description: Writes a short status text of three dashes and a closing parenthesis. It then writes a digit that is 4 when a flag is set and 3 otherwise, followed by a second flag digit.

name: build_count_text_line
description: Builds a text line from helper output and a fixed text fragment ending in times. It uses helper routines to format numbers, and the listing is cut off before the end.

name: format_elapsed_time_text
description: Converts a time value to whole minutes and hours with rounding, then writes the hour and minute text, choosing singular or plural forms.

name: write_decimal_with_prefix
description: Writes a fixed two-byte prefix, followed by a flag character when one is given. It then writes the value as decimal digits and suppresses leading zeros.

name: clear_buffer_and_set_marker
description: Clears 120 bytes at a buffer pointer, then stores a minus-two word through a second pointer.

name: write_negated_sum_checksum
description: Sums a run of 32-bit values, then stores the negated sum XORed with a fixed tag into the first field of a header.

name: xor_scramble_words_backward
description: Walks a block of 16-bit words backward, replacing each word with its XOR against the following word and a fixed constant. The count comes from the length input.

name: xor_scramble_words_forward
description: Walks a block of 16-bit words forward, replacing each word with its XOR against the next word and a fixed constant. The count is derived from a shared length value.

name: find_or_append_record_entry
description: Searches a table of 25-word entries for a matching key. When none matches and space remains, it appends a new entry, copies in a name string from the source and stores the smallest of three values. Otherwise it reports the table's current values.

name: lookup_bitmap_pixel_values
description: XORs a shared byte with an input word and looks up a table value from its high bit. It then reads a pointer from a table and computes a value from its bytes. The rest of the listing is cut off.

name: blit_pixel_rows_from_table
description: Performs the same table lookups as its sibling routine, then programs the blitter's mask, modulo, pointer, control and size registers before writing the rows. The listing is cut off before the end.

name: copy_rows_with_stride
description: Copies a run of 16-bit words, then repeatedly copies rows of twenty words, stepping back by one row of 42 bytes. The listing is cut off before the end.

name: wait_while_status_bit_set
description: Busy-waits while bit 6 of a shared status byte is set, then returns. The facts list the DMA control read register as touched, which suggests a blitter wait.

name: decode_bp_packed_image
description: Checks that the input begins with the two-letter signature BP, then unpacks a packed image by reading pairs of bytes and writing them out in runs.

name: fill_memory_block_with_byte
description: Fills a block of memory with a single byte value. It first writes one byte to reach a four-byte boundary, then writes the value in four-byte chunks and finishes any remaining bytes.

name: open_file_or_fill_colour
description: Calls a library function to open a file. If that fails, it writes a fixed colour value 256 times to the colour register. Otherwise it stores the handle and calls two more library functions on it.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords_and_call
description: If the output pointer is set, copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in the data into it, then calls a stored function pointer.

name: find_max_value_and_report
description: Program entry for the assign tool. It walks a linked list to find the largest stored value, then calls library routines to write the result, using a 140-byte stack buffer for text.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords_and_call
description: If the output pointer is set, copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in the data into it, then calls a stored function pointer.

name: run_log_merge_entry
description: Program entry for the log merge tool. It checks the first argument byte and sets a flag when it matches. An early failure returns five, while success runs further steps and returns the result of the final call.

name: run_fixed_helper_sequence
description: Runs a fixed sequence of helper calls, with one extra call when a flag is set, then returns. Beyond that sequence, the listing shows no other logic.

name: emit_entries_skipping_marked
description: Walks a list of 25-word entries and, for each entry whose key is not 1234, calls helpers to write its fields. When a name character is an ampersand, it makes one extra helper call.

name: accumulate_counts_for_two_passes
description: Runs a helper pass that adds its count to a running total. When a flag is clear, it runs a second pass with the two buffers swapped and adds that count to another total.

name: merge_two_entry_lists
description: Walks two lists of 25-word entries together and merges them, comparing their key fields and calling helpers for each matched or unmatched entry. The loop ends when the first list is exhausted.

name: copy_zero_terminated_string
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from the source to the destination, including the terminator.

name: write_negated_sum_checksum
description: Sums a run of 32-bit values, then stores the negated sum XORed with a fixed tag into the first field of a header.

name: verify_checksum_and_reset_records
description: Recomputes the checksum of a block. When the sum is non-zero, it resets a run of 50-byte records by writing fixed values into their fields.
